head.subject: Merge device-tested DP and fingerprint kernel inputs

history_method: temporary shared clone (/var/tmp/liuqin-patch-export/repo) + git fetch --deepen from upstream origin
history_limitations: The read-only upstream clone is shallow; it is NOT deepened or modified by this tool.

When the base commit was missing, a temporary shared clone under /var/tmp was fetched with `git fetch --deepen` from the GitHub origin. The queue is therefore derived from network-fetched history on first export; re-exports can reuse the temporary clone.

Patches are the non-merge commits in base..head plus (only if needed) a synthetic 9999-merge-resolution.patch; merge commits themselves are not exported because format-patch of a merge would duplicate parent content.
